SPIRE1-BIRD_FACED_URN.flavor: This urn shows the crow god Mazaleth looking mischievous.
SPIRE1-BIRD_FACED_URN.title: Bird-Faced Urn
SPIRE1-BIRD_FACED_URN.description: Whenever you play a #yPower card, heal !Heal!HP.
SPIRE1-BLACK_BLOOD.title: Black Blood
SPIRE1-BLACK_BLOOD.description: Replaces #rBurning #rBlood. At the end of combat, heal !Heal!HP.
SPIRE1-BLOODY_IDOL.flavor: The idol now weeps a constant stream of blood.
SPIRE1-BLOODY_IDOL.title: Bloody Idol
SPIRE1-BURNING_BLOOD.flavor: Your body's own blood burns with an undying rage.
SPIRE1-BURNING_BLOOD.title: Burning Blood
SPIRE1-BURNING_BLOOD.description: At the end of combat, heal !Heal!HP.
SPIRE1-CRACKED_CORE.flavor: The mysterious life force which powers the Automatons within the Spire. It appears to be cracked.
SPIRE1-CRACKED_CORE.title: Cracked Core
SPIRE1-CRACKED_CORE.description: At the start of each combat, #yChannel #b1 #yLightning.
SPIRE1-ENCHIRIDION.flavor: The legendary journal of an ancient lich.
SPIRE1-ENCHIRIDION.title: Enchiridion
SPIRE1-ENCHIRIDION.description: At the start of each combat, add a random #yPower card into your hand. It costs #b0 for that turn.
SPIRE1-GOLDEN_IDOL.flavor: Made of solid gold, you feel richer just holding it.
SPIRE1-GOLDEN_IDOL.title: Golden Idol
SPIRE1-GIRYA.flavor: This Girya is unfathomably heavy. You could train with this to get significantly stronger.
SPIRE1-GIRYA.title: Girya
SPIRE1-GIRYA.description: At the start of each combat, gain !StrengthPower! Strength.
SPIRE1-KUNAI.flavor: A blade favored by assassins for its lethality at range.
SPIRE1-KUNAI.title: Kunai
SPIRE1-KUNAI.description: Every time you play !Cards!#yAttacks in a single turn, gain !DexterityPower!#yDexterity.
SPIRE1-MAGIC_FLOWER.flavor: A flower long thought extinct, somehow preserved in perfect condition.
SPIRE1-MAGIC_FLOWER.title: Magic Flower
SPIRE1-MAGIC_FLOWER.description: Healing is #b50% more effective during combat.
SPIRE1-MUTAGENIC_STRENGTH.flavor: "The results seem fleeting, triggering when the subject is in danger." - Unknown
SPIRE1-MUTAGENIC_STRENGTH.title: Mutagenic Strength
SPIRE1-MUTAGENIC_STRENGTH.description: Start each combat with !StrengthPower!#yStrength. At the end of your first turn, lose !StrengthPower!#yStrength.
SPIRE1-NECRONOMICON.flavor: Only a fool would try and harness this evil power. At night your dreams are haunted by images of the book devouring your mind.
SPIRE1-NECRONOMICON.title: Necronomicon
SPIRE1-NECRONOMICON.description:
The first #yAttack played each turn that costs !Energy!or more is played twice. Upon pickup, obtain a special #rCurse.
 or more is played twice.
SPIRE1-PEN_NIB.flavor: Holding the nib, you can see everyone ever slain by a previous owner of the pen. A violent history.
SPIRE1-PEN_NIB.title: Pen Nib
SPIRE1-PEN_NIB.description: Every #b10th #yAttack you play deals double damage.
SPIRE1-RUNIC_CUBE.title: Runic Cube
SPIRE1-SHURIKEN.flavor: Lightweight throwing weapons. Recommend going for the eyes.
SPIRE1-SHURIKEN.title: Shuriken
SPIRE1-SHURIKEN.description: Every time you play !Cards!#yAttacks in a single turn, gain !StrengthPower!#yStrength.
SPIRE1-SPIRIT_POOP.flavor: The charred remains of your offering to the spirits.
SPIRE1-SPIRIT_POOP.title: Spirit Poop
SPIRE1-TOOLBOX.title: Toolbox
SPIRE1-TOOLBOX.description: At the start of each combat, choose #b1 of #b3 random Colorless cards and add the chosen card into your hand.
SPIRE1-WARPED_TONGS.flavor: The cursed tongs emit a strong desire to return to where they were stolen from.
SPIRE1-WARPED_TONGS.title: Warped Tongs
SPIRE1-WARPED_TONGS.description: At the start of your turn, #yUpgrade a random card in your hand for the rest of combat.
SPIRE1-MARK_OF_PAIN.title: Mark of Pain
SPIRE1-MARK_OF_PAIN.description: Gain [R] at the start of your turn. At the start of combat, shuffle #b2 #rWounds into your draw pile.
SPIRE1-MARK_OF_PAIN.flavor: This brand was used by the northern tribes to signify warriors who had mastered pain in battle.
SPIRE1-MARK_OF_THE_BLOOM.title: Mark of the Bloom
SPIRE1-MARK_OF_THE_BLOOM.flavor: In the Beyond, thoughts and reality are one.
SPIRE1-RING_OF_THE_SNAKE.title: Ring of the Snake
SPIRE1-RING_OF_THE_SNAKE.description: At the start of each combat, draw 2additional cards.
SPIRE1-RING_OF_THE_SNAKE.flavor: Made from a fossilized snake. Represents great skill as a huntress.
SPIRE1-NILRYS_CODEX.title: Nilry's Codex
SPIRE1-NILRYS_CODEX.description: At the end of your turn, you may shuffle #b1 of #b3 random cards into your draw pile.
SPIRE1-NILRYS_CODEX.flavor: Crafted by the infamous game master himself. Said to expand one's mind.
